claims.text: At the core of Git is a simple key-value data store
claims.quote: It means that at the core of Git is a simple key-value data store.

claims.text: All content is stored as tree and blob objects
claims.quote: All the content is stored as tree and blob objects, with trees corresponding to UNIX directory entries and blobs corresponding more or less to inodes or file contents.

claims.text: A commit specifies the top-level tree for the snapshot of the project
claims.quote: it specifies the top-level tree for the snapshot of the project at that point

claims.text: To save space an object may be stored as a delta of a base object in a pack
claims.quote: Conceptually there are only four object types: commit, tree, tag and blob. However to save space, an object could be stored as a "delta" of another "base" object.
